message:
Calm seed header — tap the heading for member cards (Slack/WhatsApp)

The header scattered loose buttons (🔒 Private ⌄, ＋ Add people) that read as
clutter. Now it's one calm tappable line — member faces + "N members ·
Private ⌄" — exactly like a Slack channel or WhatsApp group header. Tapping
it opens the details sheet, which now leads with a member-faces card
("N members · See all ›") + a clear ＋ Add, then the existing notifications /
visibility / settings rows. Removed the redundant standalone Add button and
the duplicate "Add members" grid action.
